reasoning: Evidence: Q3-26 revenue $14.6B (SI $7.6B), Adj. EBITDA $8.8B, 1.7 GW nameplate, Q4 capex guide $35-40B (2.1x the Aug guide), Q1-27 revenue guide $33-37B, Musk 13 GW YE27. Alternative-lane reads: GPU rental indices are rising (H100 $2.88, +10% in a week; A100 flat at $1.57; B200 ~$5.7), so the shortage holds near term, but SpaceX's ~$50+/W-yr is ~1.6x the market per-watt Blackwell rate and both anchor contracts are 90-day cancellable (Cape Fear, FWP); the 2024-25 H100 repricing (-64%) is the base rate for what happens when supply lands, and hyperscaler capex of ~$1.3T in 2027 is that supply. SemiAnalysis argues 10 GW is real; Tunguz shows OCF covered 12% of capex in H1-26 and bonds yield 5.9-7.5%. Judgment: YE27 8.5 GW (GPU deployment and funding cap), new-chip price holds ~$50 through 2027 then fades to ~$21 (break-even ~$18.5) by 2033. On Kilian's legs this gives $79 fair value (EV/EBITDA 12x $112, SOTP $54, P/E 20x $65); Kilian's 15x/27x would give ~$97. The 12-month price is not my fair value: the 2027 earnings ramp is visible and the fade is a 2028+ story, so I let the market keep a premium in the base ($120) and give a 22% bull at $230; bear $70 is convergence to fundamentals on an early repricing. Ladder = lognormal mix (bear 70/0.30 sd, base 120/0.24, bull 230/0.27; weights 0.30/0.48/0.22); P(>= $152) ~29%. Prediction markets: Polymarket merger 42.5% by Jun-27; Manifold FY27 revenue >$100B only 33% (thin). Research limits: X/Twitter not fetched; S&P and Moody's pages blocked.

FY2028 is the year the horizon multiples read. Net debt at the horizon and shares are stated directly (capex is far above the FCF bridge's percentages).
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) EV/EBITDA 12x instead of the standing 15x and P/E 20x instead of 27x: the NTM figures embed $42-50/W-yr pricing against a ~$18.5 break-even and 90-day-cancellable leases; at 15x/27x fair value would be ~$97 (+22%). (2) YE27 capacity 8.5 GW (vs 13 guided). (3) Price path holds through 2027 and fades to ~$21 by 2033. (4) Top-level scenarios are 12-month PRICE scenarios ($70/$120/$230) that allow the market to keep paying for the 2027 earnings ramp; the engine's fundamental scenarios are $52/$79/$116. (5) Fleet cash flows start at the horizon (Nov-27 to Oct-28 = 2/12 CY27 + 10/12 CY28); Q4-27 adds are prepaid before H.
